lastCompletedLayerName: Workload data, storage locality, network dependencies, and end-to-end reproducibility
reason: Integrated the observation-only DependencyProfile capability into UX-ROM with redacted storage-locality metadata, cloud/offline/recall detection, explicitly declared timeout-bounded TCP readiness probes, observer calibration, unique evidence files, and a stable condition signature. The final lab run classified the declared path as a present OneDrive-root location on fixed NTFS storage, completed 5 of 5 declared endpoint probes, measured 1.075 ms median path-inventory cost, and excluded the raw path and host from evidence. An optional-event-journal permission failure was preserved and corrected without hiding primary evidence or probe failures. No file content or Windows setting changed and no performance-gain claim was made.
